name: Podiatry clinic
summary: How expats find podiatry care in Singapore — heel pain, diabetic foot checks, orthotics, and AHPC-registered podiatrists versus retail insoles.
body:
Podiatrists assess foot and ankle problems: plantar fasciitis, ingrown nails, sports injuries, and diabetic foot risk. Custom orthotics differ from mall cushioning inserts — assessment quality matters.

## Decision points
- GP referral vs direct private podiatry
- Acute heel / Achilles pain pathways
- Diabetic foot screening cadence
- Custom orthotics vs off-the-shelf insoles
- Sports return-to-run plans after injury

Bring current shoes you actually walk and run in.

## How to choose
Prefer AHPC-registered podiatrists who examine gait and shoes, not only sell inserts. Ask about review visits after orthotics. Confirm imaging referral pathways if stress fracture is suspected.

## Practical tip
Do not jump to the thickest gel insole after one sore run. Book assessment before stacking random cushioning that changes your gait.
